headline: Impex Ferro Tech Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Impex Ferro Tech Limited (IFTL) has initiated Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, with the company filing a postfacto intimation to NSE regarding the 28th board meeting at which the CIRP was likely resolved.
detail: Impex Ferro Tech Limited, a listed entity on NSE, has communicated its entry into the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The company filed a postfacto intimation document (dated 22 Jun 2026) to the NSE concerning resolutions passed at its 28th Board of Directors meeting. Under IBC 2016, CIRP typically follows either a company or creditor application alleging default; the process suspends all ongoing suits and vests control in a court-appointed Insolvency Professional. The company's board intimation suggests formal corporate governance steps were taken to acknowledge or notify the process to the stock exchange, as mandated by SEBI Listing Rules.
